run_sync_openai_translation: run sync_openai to translate an audio file using the OpenAI client and vLLM model
run_stream_openai_translation: run stream_openai_response to stream audio translation from a vLLM server via SSE
run_main_translation_client: run main to translate an audio asset using both sync and streaming OpenAI translation APIs
test_sync_openai: test sync_openai with an audio file path, OpenAI client, and model name
test_stream_openai_response: test stream_openai_response with audio path, base URL, API key, and model name
